observationsNotFindings: This artifact fills a gap two earlier artifacts explicitly recorded and refused to fill themselves. G07 v3's leftoverNameNote and the catalog's leftoverJoinStanding both state that no leftover-join for this gate exists and that they are not it. Naming the absence rather than quietly leaving it is what made this join's arrival auditable, and the join cites both sentences rather than asserting its own necessity.

OBL-FILESYSTEM-COVERAGE is the most unusual open obligation I have reviewed in this sweep, and the join states it without softening: the live G07 harness cell names supported filesystems, and that set exists in no live governing source. The remainder is therefore not merely unauthored but unsourced, and G07 v3's own laterAct contemplates that a future act may have to record that no live source exists. A coordinator should not expect this to close by ordinary fixture work.

Two of the eight obligations exist solely to refuse another row's leftover. OBL-UNICODE-NORM-RIDES-DR103 and OBL-DR103-NOT-STOLEN both carry rides-DR-103 and name the five DR-103 leftovers that stay on component-manifest-leftover-join.v4. Spending obligation slots on non-acquisition is a strong form of the refusal, and it matters here because G07's exact-bytes subject matter sits adjacent to DR-103's path and envelope classes.

treeRootDigest is handled the way the G07 harness chain established: named as a schemas.v11 RESERVED BINDING POINT under RJ-6, parked on the DR-006 freeze section 7.1, and left without a value. Naming the parking place is not authoring the recipe, and no digest appears anywhere near the token.
